description: PALs Paths character registry (SPEC Feature 50.3 + 50.8). Canonical disambiguated snake_case IDs for Traditional story character path membership. Editing this file is an owner-approved change — character IDs are an API contract once shipped. The `jesus` entry is reserved for the special jesus_life path and must NEVER appear in the Characters path list.

aaron.descriptor: Brother of Moses, first high priest

aquila.descriptor: Husband of Priscilla, co-worker with Paul

bartimaeus.descriptor: Blind beggar healed by Jesus at Jericho

caleb.descriptor: Faithful spy who trusted God's promise

esther.descriptor: Queen of Persia, saved her people

hagar.descriptor: Servant of Sarah, mother of Ishmael

jairus.descriptor: Synagogue ruler whose daughter Jesus raised

james_brother_of_jesus.descriptor: Brother of Jesus, leader of early Jerusalem church

james_son_zebedee.descriptor: Disciple, son of Zebedee, brother of John

jehoshaphat.descriptor: King of Judah who trusted God in battle

jesus.descriptor: Jesus of Nazareth — reserved for The Life of Jesus path (SPEC Feature 50.1b / 50.8). NEVER appears in the Characters path list.

john_apostle.descriptor: Apostle, beloved disciple, Gospel of John

john_disciple.descriptor: Disciple of Jesus, son of Zebedee

joseph.descriptor: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

joseph_son_of_jacob.descriptor: Son of Jacob, dreamer in Egypt

joshua.descriptor: Successor to Moses, led Israel into Canaan

lydia.descriptor: Seller of purple, early convert in Philippi

mary_of_bethany.descriptor: Sister of Martha and Lazarus, Luke/John

matthew.descriptor: Tax collector, apostle, Gospel of Matthew

miriam.descriptor: Sister of Moses and Aaron, Exodus

mordecai.descriptor: Guardian of Esther who exposed Haman's plot, Esther

naboth.descriptor: Owner of vineyard killed by Jezebel, 1 Kings

paul_apostle.descriptor: Apostle to the Gentiles, formerly Saul of Tarsus

peter.descriptor: Disciple of Jesus, leader of the early church

samuel.descriptor: Prophet who anointed Saul and David

sarah.descriptor: Wife of Abraham, mother of Isaac

shadrach.descriptor: Three men in the fiery furnace

simon_peter.descriptor: Disciple of Jesus, Simon son of Jonah

solomon.descriptor: Wise king of Israel, David's son

stephen_martyr.descriptor: First martyr of the early church
